limitations: This is a static program review, not an independent ground-truth adjudication or quality evaluation.
Both cases proposals are independent same-root proposals; the second is not a sequential repair of the first.
No claims about semantic support, task correctness, or causal value of feedback condition follow from successful materialization.
method: Independent read-only source reconstruction and AST comparison; archived candidates were never imported or executed.
public_payload_policy: No original question, reference answer, quote, document identifier, or raw model prose is included.

records.budget_effect: No new model-call or retrieval loops; final input is larger within existing caps.
records.intent_implementation_alignment: Partial: the stated forced abstention is not implemented; answer text, answer_usable and abstained remain unchanged by the new guard.
records.mechanism: Stricter answer instructions, bridge-entity input, and an answer-support diagnostic guard.
static_risks: The new guard is candidate-side diagnostic logic, not a new host-enforced semantic fact check.
Bridge entities are checked for literal occurrence in the question or read text; this does not validate the intermediate relation.
Citation count is not hop coverage, and the guard counts stored citations rather than the actual returned or presented subset.
The added bridge_entities field is not included in compaction order, so it can displace original quotes under a tight payload budget.

records.budget_effect: No new model-call or retrieval loops; input grows while the existing payload cap and evidence-preserving compaction still apply.
records.intent_implementation_alignment: The prompt/data-flow changes are implemented. Per-hop correctness remains model-assessed, not mechanically verified.
records.mechanism: Stricter per-hop answer instructions and bridge-entity input with explicit compaction and omission accounting.
static_risks: Literal occurrence of bridge entities does not establish the relation chain or semantic support.
More conservative answering may alter abstention and correct-answer rates; static inspection cannot establish the direction.
Bridge entities enter the final input but are removable before evidence when the payload needs compaction.

records.inference_limit: The rejection text reports a truncated or missing response; no mechanism or source-change conclusion is inferred from absent code.
records.mechanism: Not assessable: no accepted structured response exists.
Intended bounded second answer attempt after an initial abstention or unusable answer.
static_risks: Every edit has a forbidden old_occurrences key, and one edit also has identical old/new text.
The proposed answer_retry semantic action is not accepted by the host complete-stage whitelist.
No second final-answer slot is actually reserved; it only tries when budget appears to remain, and the existing local non-answer reservation rule can block the attempt.
The retry predicate does not cover a nonabstaining usable answer with invalid citations, despite the stated intent.
The proposed retry accepts a nonabstaining parseable response without requiring r_valid or r_sufficient.
This proposal adds a new control-flow idea, but it was rejected before any candidate measurement.
